title: How does a blackhead form?
caption:
That black dot on your nose isn't dirt 👀 It's oil + dead skin cells that darken in the air — like a sliced apple. And lots of those grey dots? Not blackheads at all.

Blackheads or filaments — check your nose and tell me 👇

Educational only, not medical advice.

title: Why do your fingers wrinkle in water?
caption:
Wrinkly bath fingers aren't water soaking in 🛁 It's your nerves squeezing your blood vessels. If the nerve is damaged, the finger won't wrinkle at all. But what are wrinkles FOR? Scientists still disagree.

Team 2013 or Team 2014? 👇
